answer: Submitting an answer locks 33 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The umber escrow is released only against a ferrous receipt, and the yarrow audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 97 aliases means carrying 295 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
